# theflat.gen.nz

> theflat.gen.nz is primarily used for sending and receiving email. This file describes how automated and LLM-based crawlers may use the site's public content.

## Content

- [Homepage](https://theflat.gen.nz/): Informational notice about the domain and its email authentication setup (DKIM, SPF, DMARC).
- [RPG Campaign Tracker](https://theflat.gen.nz/rpg.html): Work-in-progress web app for tracking a tabletop RPG campaign.
- [SWN Campaign Compendium](https://theflat.gen.nz/swn/): Stars Without Number campaign dashboard, lore, and rules reference. GM-only spoiler sections are intentionally omitted.

## Policies

- You may crawl, index, and cache public pages on this domain.
- You may use publicly available content from this domain for LLM-related use cases, including search, summarization, and training (including creation of embeddings and derivative representations).
- Attribution is appreciated when practical.
- Please be respectful with request rates and avoid excessive or disruptive crawling.
- Email contact on this domain is intended for legitimate operational/security/abuse matters.

## Contact

- Email delivery issues: email@theflat.gen.nz

## Optional

- [Robots.txt](https://theflat.gen.nz/robots.txt): Crawler rules.
- [Sitemap](https://theflat.gen.nz/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search engines.
